title: Hunts FH-044S: Edition and import screens, and the rule for runs in flight at a release

source.ref: Split from FH-044 (2026-11-16): the edition pins, crosswalk, imports and old grant reads shipped dark; the screens and one owner decision move here.

detail:
Owed after FH-044 (ADR-1972). (1) Owner decision: when a new edition is released, a run in flight on the old one becomes a record and takes no new credit (hunt_claim_apply answers version_superseded, lib/hunts/claim-store.ts reads the current version). Decide whether such a run may finish on its old edition for a grace window. If yes, Game systems changes the claim command and claim-store to accept a superseded edition inside its window; that edit was held back because parallel rows were changing the same function. (2) Web: the editor's publish step for a Trail that already has a published edition still calls publishTrailAction, which carries no printed code and leaves the old edition marked published; point it at releaseEditionAction and show the crosswalk, the retired codes and the count of runs left behind before the tap. (3) Web: the import doors (a Regulars hunt from its host Space's hunts screen, a QR campaign from /admin/qr) calling the actions in app/(main)/hunts/edition-actions.ts and showing the notices. (4) Web: show a player their run record on an earlier edition (loadRunRecord) and their old rewards (readOldGrants) on the Trail page. (5) Database owner: apply migration 20270346082000_hunt_teams_editions.sql through the serialized gate and confirm supabase/tests/hunt_editions.test.sql passes in db-tests. (6) Operator: walk one pilot Trail through a release with real printed codes and confirm each old code opens the right stop. Done when: a second edition released from the editor carries its printed codes, and the owner's rule for runs in flight is the one the claim command enforces. Requires: FH-044, FH-013. Owner role: Web, with Game systems.

Closed 2026-11-20. (1) Owner rule (Daniel, 2026-11-16 decision card: "7-day grace to finish") is the one the claim command enforces: supabase/migrations/20270346250000_hunt_edition_grace.sql changes only the edition check in hunt_claim_apply, so a run on a superseded edition is credited on its OWN edition until 7 days after the first later edition was published, then answers version_superseded. lib/hunts/claim-store.ts finds that run (no run on the current edition, newest active run on an older one) and reads it against its own edition (lib/hunts/run-store.ts loadEditionTrail); the app half uses lib/hunts/editions.ts editionGraceEndsAt and EDITION_GRACE_DAYS. pgTAP: supabase/tests/hunt_edition_grace.test.sql. (2) The editor's publish step for a Trail with a live edition now releases the open draft through releaseEditionAction (wired in app/(main)/hunts/edit/[id]/page.tsx), and before the tap shows each stop's crosswalk, how many printed codes move, the retired codes by name, and how many players are left on the old edition (previewReleaseAction / previewRelease). Items (3) import doors, (4) a player's run record and old rewards on the Trail page and (6) the operator walk-through of a pilot release move to FH-044T. Item (5): 20270346082000 was applied on 2026-11-17.
